notes: Threads no longer stay on "Watching" after the model says it is done: the driver now settles on the CLI's own in-flight task list, not a task level that can go stale. drivers/claude.ts trusted system/background_tasks_changed alone for the live set; in a CosmicPrisons thread the CLI stopped sending that level mid-session while fifteen more tasks started and reported, so two ids from the last level held every later turn in 'watching' for hours (three other threads showed the same shape). The Stop hook's background_tasks (running/pending) now replaces the set at every turn end (crons as before); a task_notification or a terminal task_updated retires its task at once; ambient ids seen on task_started or the level are ignored wherever they turn up; and a foreground command the tool timeout moved to the background never holds the thread (the model did not choose to wait on it, only 7 of 19 such tasks ever reported, and one sat "live" for hours after its process died). Tests in claude-tasks.test.ts cover each source and order.
